Your game library. Every game is a **profile**: GameTimeNext records how long you play it, keeps track of your playthroughs and shows your progress. Running games are detected automatically, so GameTimeNext will switch to the correct profile.
![fullApp][img-1]
## Quick start
1. Click **＋ Add profile** and enter the name of the game.
2. Set the **game folder** (the folder that contains the game's `.exe` - used for Running detection).
3. Save, then start the game as usual.
> [!TIP]
> For Steam games use **Steam import** in the profile: name, game folder and data are filled in for you.
> You can also start steam linked games via GameTimeNext (""Launch"" button)
## The library
The list on the left shows all your profiles. Select one to see its details on the right.

## Recording playtime
- **By hand**: with **Start monitoring** in the profile details.
- **Hotkey**: in **Settings → Monitoring hotkey** you can set a key that starts and stops monitoring for the current profile from anywhere, even while you are in the game.
> [!IMPORTANT]
> Playtime is always recorded in a **playthrough**. If no playthrough is running, GameTimeNext asks whether a new one should be started.
## Playthroughs
A playthrough is one run through a game, e.g. your first run or a later completionist run. You manage it through the context menu → **Playthroughs**:
- **Show playthroughs**: all playthroughs of the profile
- **Current playthrough completed**: marks the running playthrough as finished
- **Cancel current playthrough**: ends it without completing it
- **Start new playthrough**: begins a new run

## Creating and editing a profile
### General
- **Profile**: the name shown in the library
- **Platform**: where you play the game. The 🧙 wizard adds a new platform.
- **Game folder**: the folder that contains the game's `.exe`. Needed to detect the game.
- **Target play style**: *Story*, *Story + Extras* or *Completionist*. It decides which estimated time the progress bar uses.
- **Enter manual**: enter the estimated times yourself. The dialog has a link to *HowLongToBeat*.
![Editview][img-5]
### Image
Set the cover with **Browse local…** (an image file) or **SteamGridDB…** (search on SteamGridDB - only available with valid API Key), then crop it to the cover format.
### Steam
- **Steam import**: takes over name, folder and data of an installed Steam game
- **Steam launch arguments**: extra start options, e.g. `-novid -fullscreen`
- **Remove link**: unlinks the profile from Steam
### Appearance
- **Change accent colors based on this profile**: the app takes on the colors of the cover while this profile is active.
- **Enable HDR on game start**: switches Windows HDR on when the game starts.

- **Blackout side monitors**: darkens your other monitors while the game is running. With **override global blackout**, this profile uses its own setting instead of the one in *Settings → Monitoring*.
### Tags
Free tags to group your games, e.g. *Co-op* or *Backlog*. You can filter the library by them.
## Tips
- Archive games you are done with instead of deleting them: the playtime stays in your statistics.
- Use **Recently played only** to quickly find the games you are currently playing.
